paper.title: Regulating Conglomerates Evidence from an Energy Conservation Program in China

abstract.reason: 论文首页包含可识别的摘要（P1.2-P1.5），明确陈述研究问题、方法、主要结果与政策含义。

evidence.quote:
Carlos Suárez Serrato, and Daniel Yi Xu*
We study a prominent energy regulation affecting large Chinese man-
ufacturers that are part of broader conglomerates. Using detailed 
­firm-level data and

­difference-in-differences research designs, we 
show that regulated firms cut output and shifted some production 
to unregulated firms within their conglomerate instead of improv-
ing their energy efficiency. To

account for conglomerate and market 
spillovers, we interpret these results through the lens of an indus-
try equilibrium model featuring conglomerate production. The pol-
icy raises welfare if the ­per ton benefits of

carbon reduction exceed 
$161. Alternative policies that exploit public information on busi-
ness networks can increase aggregate energy savings by 10 percent.  
(JEL D22, L22, L51, L60, P28, P31, Q48)

field.reason: 按步骤3.2，论文有实证，核心自变量为是否受Top 1,000项目管制（Treat×Post），核心因变量为企业能源使用、产出和能源效率。管制变量属于环境规制/产业政策，能源使用与产出属于企业生产与能源经济范畴，均为经管类，故判定为核心经管。

variables.name: Treat × Post（是否受Top 1,000项目管制）
variables.reason: 环境规制政策变量，属于经管类中的环境经济学与产业政策研究范畴。

variables.reason: 企业产出/经济绩效，属于产业组织与企业经济学核心变量。
